list.name: LoadId
list.label: Lote
list.query: select LoadId from TestLoad where Status = 'Succeeded' order by CreatedAt desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia visible para interpretar los cuadros de planificacion de capacidad.

options.content:
### Que muestra
Este tablero ayuda a planificar capacidad: crecimiento mensual, fecha estimada de agotamiento, headroom, baseline, sobredimensionamiento y subdimensionamiento.

### Como interpretarlo
MonthlyGrowthRate alto acelera la demanda; DaysToSaturation bajo indica urgencia; HeadroomAvailable alto con baja utilizacion sugiere sobredimensionamiento; HeadroomAvailable bajo sugiere subdimensionamiento.

### Accion sugerida
Revisar primero Underprovisioned Resources para evitar saturacion y luego Overprovisioned Resources para optimizar costos/capacidad.

panels.title: Monthly Growth
panels.description: MonthlyGrowthRate by resource for planning trend analysis.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.MonthlyGrowthRate from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by k.MonthlyGrowthRate desc, k.CalculatedAt desc limit 30

panels.title: Exhaustion Date Estimate
panels.description: Forecast30Days, Forecast60Days, Forecast90Days, and DaysToSaturation for planning decisions.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, f.ResourceId) as HostName, f.ResourceId, f.MetricName, f.Forecast30Days, f.Forecast60Days, f.Forecast90Days, f.DaysToSaturation from ForecastResult f left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = f.ResourceId where f.ForecastResultId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by f.DaysToSaturation asc, f.CalculatedAt desc limit 30

panels.title: Headroom And Baseline
panels.description: HeadroomAvailable and BaselineDelta for sizing and baseline comparison.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.HeadroomAvailable, k.BaselineDelta, k.AverageUtilization, k.PeakUtilization, k.P95Utilization from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by k.HeadroomAvailable asc, k.CalculatedAt desc limit 30

panels.title: Overprovisioned Resources
panels.description: Resources with high available headroom and low average utilization.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization, k.HeadroomAvailable, k.BaselineDelta from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and k.HeadroomAvailable >= 70 order by k.HeadroomAvailable desc limit 20

panels.title: Underprovisioned Resources
panels.description: Resources with limited headroom or short days-to-saturation.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.HeadroomAvailable, f.DaysToSaturation, f.Forecast90Days from CapacityKpi k left join ForecastResult f on f.ResourceId = k.ResourceId and f.ForecastResultId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and (k.HeadroomAvailable <= 25 or f.DaysToSaturation <= 90) order by k.HeadroomAvailable asc, f.DaysToSaturation asc limit 20

panels.title: Saturation Trend
panels.description: Saturation time series by resource and verification scenario. Missing data means no saturation samples are available.
